messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood - CCMC outcome and directions
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

The costs and case management conference was heard yesterday before Harewood J. The Court made the directions order broadly as we proposed: extended disclosure (Model C) by 27 March, exchange of witness statements by 22 May, single forensic accountant each on quantum with reports by 17 July, and a 5-day trial in a window opening 18 January 2027. Our costs budget was approved at £612,000.

The sealed order will follow from the court; I'll circulate it once received. Next focus is disclosure and your witness statement.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
